Nagare 1.4.0 adds media filters, YouTube logging, and updates for Tadoku sign-in.

- **Choose what gets tracked:** each media server now has library and folder filters. Use a whitelist or blacklist in **Config → Server → Libraries & folders**; existing history is kept.
- **Log YouTube videos to Tadoku:** the optional standalone userscript adds a **Log to Tadoku** button to desktop YouTube. It logs the full video duration as Japanese listening minutes, with a `youtube` tag and the video link. Install `/youtube-tadoku.user.js` from your Nagare server; see the [setup guide](https://github.com/bpwhelan/Nagare/blob/main/docs/userscript.md#youtube--tadoku-standalone).
- **Updated Tadoku sign-in and sync:** supports Tadoku's new account system, reuses saved sessions, and preserves sync history and duplicate protection. Saved emails and passwords carry over; replace a saved username with your Tadoku email if needed. Export retries no longer add internal batch IDs as tags.
- **Kechimochi character counts:** synced activities now include non-whitespace characters from saved subtitles up to each watch's recorded playback position. Existing managed logs update on the next sync.
- **Mobile navigation during playback:** the menu button keeps navigation accessible while media is playing, with playback controls still available.
